top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards a compact mechanism (bulk gap with protected edge states classified by a Z2 invariant) with a sharp prediction and a decisive experiment in HgTe quantum wells, confirmed by two decades of independent work and carried into photonics, cold atoms, mechanics and superconductors. A citation restricted to the two-dimensional quantum spin Hall chain credits Kane, Mele and Molenkamp coherently without adjudicating the Fu-Kane 3D or ARPES priority questions. P001 (optical lattice clock) is mature, cleanly attributed and well replicated, so it is a close second, but it rests more on an enabling technique than on a new organising principle. Either is preferable to no award.
